the marque’s proud history of stunning styling and technological

It is also a key part of Italy’s long and illustrious automotive tradition.

creates exceptional cars in which performance can be experienced to the

THE MASERATI GRANTURISMO RANGE
OUTSTANDING ROAD PERFORMANCE
It was 1947. The original idea of installing a racing engine in a roadgoing car gave birth to the famed A6
1500 GT Pininfarina, the first Maserati GT.
Ever since then, Maserati has led the world in the production of dynamic and desirable performance cars that
are exciting to drive, comfortable for passengers, and featuring the very highest levels of safety. 60 years later,
the dream lives on with the Maserati GranTurismo range, comprising the GranTurismo, GranTurismo Sport and
GranTurismo MC Stradale: cars that combine prestige, elegance and immense power - created for those who
live life to the full and seek uncompromising motoring enjoyment.
5
INTRODUCTION

--- page 8 ---
MASERATI GRANTURISMO SPORT.
OPPOSITES ATTRACT
The GranTurismo Sport is the latest evolution of the Maserati coupé concept, of which the GranTurismo is already
a magnificent example. This superb Maserati has reached new levels of design, technical sophistication, handling
and performance, without compromising the onboard comfort in any way.
Available in two versions, with either automatic or robotic manual transmissions, the GranTurismo Sport is the perfect
blend of sportiness and elegance also in the new pearlescent paint Grigio Lava – a car of extraordinary character,
designed to satisfy the world’s most enthusiastic and demanding drivers.
6
INTRODUCTION

--- page 10 ---
DESIGNED WITH PASSION
Seeing the GranTurismo Sport in the metal can be guaranteed to set the pulse racing. While maintaining
the balanced, seductive styling of the original GranTurismo, universally acknowledged to be one of the
most beautiful coupés of all time, the Maserati Style Centre has worked mainly on the front to give the car
an even more dynamic look.
8
exTeRIOR

--- page 13 ---
The front bumper has completely new air intakes, which not only improve the flow of air and cooling of the front
brakes, but also act as a stylistic intersection between the traditional oval grille and the new headlights with their
LED Daytime Running Lights. The centre of the grille features the Trident symbol in chrome with red detailing: a
tradition reserved for only the most powerful Maseratis. The central splitter, offered in black as standard, can be
specified in the same colour as the body or in carbon fibre. The rear end then displays a tail light moulding with a
special burnished finish that accentuates the effect of the 96 LEDs when they light up. The oval exhaust tailpipes
are black, in line with the standard Shadow Line finish. The Chrome Line option, with its numerous chrome-plated
finishes, is available on request.
11
exTeRIOR

--- page 14 ---
The visual drama, power and street presence of the GranTurismo Sport are enhanced by the innovative metallescent
Blu Sofisticato finish, a colour which makes the car even more alluring. Behind the 20” Astro Design alloy wheels,
the Brembo brake callipers can be clearly seen. These are available in Matt Anodized Blue, a unique finish that
further accentuates the sporting character of this very special car.
12
exTeRIOR

--- page 19 ---
ERGONOMIC SPORTS INTERIOR
The interior of the GranTurismo Sport is a masterpiece of expert craftsmanship, top quality materials, obsessive
attention to detail and superb ergonomic design. The objective was to prioritise the needs of sporty driving
whilst, at the same time, ensuring the highest levels of comfort and spaciousness for the passengers.
The sporty nature of the GranTurismo Sport’s interior is evident in the use of Alcantara® combined with traditional
Poltrona Frau® leather, along with the Dark Chrome and Eco Chrome detailing on the dashboard, door panels and
quarter panels.
17
INTeRIOR

--- page 20 ---
FRONT SEATS
The sporty front seats with integrated headrests are a completely new design, the result of a skilful
combination of aesthetics and functionality. Both the driver and passengers of the GranTurismo Sport are thus
able to enjoy extremely comfortable seating along with good posture support at high speeds. This has been
achieved by the seats being redesigned, their width expanded to 300 mm, and the volume of the quarter panels
increased.
The seat design, which is a distinctive feature even from the outside, gives the car a very sporty look, and is completed
by a bezel modelled on the Maserati grille. Located at the base of the headrests, this element further enhances the
elegance of the interior. The edges of the seat back then feature intricate stitching to highlight the craftsmanship that
is inherent in the brand.
18
INTeRIOR

--- page 22 ---
REAR SEATS
The rear seats adopt the same sporty design as the front seats, and also give rear passengers an extremely
comfortable, anatomically supported posture. In addition, the structure of the front seat means that rear
legroom has been increased by 20 mm to ensure the highest levels of comfort even on the longest journeys.
The layout of the rear seats is the same as that found in the rest of the GranTurismo range, with two single
adult-size seats divided by the central tunnel.
20
INTeRIOR

--- page 25 ---
THE NEW MAN-MACHINE INTERFACE
Dialoguing with the GranTurismo Sport is an emotional experience: you feel this as soon as you take hold
of the new flat-crown steering wheel with its boldly profiled grip, behind which the elongated Trofeo-design
gearshift paddles are perfectly positioned for your fingers. Mounted on the steering column, they are longer
than usual to ensure precise control when continually changing gear - even on the most winding of roads. The
lightweight pedals in perforated aluminium enhance the feeling of involvement, providing a direct link between
the driver’s intuitive skills and the car’s response.
The instrument panel is highly legible in all lighting conditions and, with its digital rev counter, clearly displays
exactly the right time for gear shifts. This can be specified with the graphics of the GranTurismo MC Stradale as an
optional extra.
23
INTeRIOR

--- page 29 ---
ONE SOUL. TWO TECHNOLOGIES.
The GranTurismo Sport pushes back the frontiers of sporty driving with its numerous high-tech
innovations. Maserati engineers have significantly modified the engine and suspension, and also the
transmission, which is now available in two versions: automatic MC Auto Shift, or robotic sequential
MC Shift. Their single objective has been to provide the driver with a car that is as close as possible to
perfection across all dynamics
27
TeChNOlOgy

--- page 30 ---
AHEAD OF ITS TIME
The GranTurismo Sport’s 4.7 litre V8 engine is the industry’s benchmark for high performance,
smoothness and reliability. The engine inherits the mechanical sophistication which has always been a
Maserati hallmark, combined with numerous innovative solutions. The increase in displacement, compared
to the existing 4.2 litre V8 powerplant, has been achieved whilst keeping down the unit’s weight and size;
its steel cylinder linings are a major contributory factor here.
The special DLC (Diamond-Like Coating) of the camshaft lobes and tappets significantly reduces wear, as
does the optimised-flow wet sump lubrication. All this, combined with precise engine mapping and reinforced
pistons, helps deliver tremendous power: up to 460 HP at 7,000 rpm. The maximum torque has also been
boosted by 10 Nm, peaking now at 520 Nm which is delivered right up through the rev range to guarantee a
responsive, smooth drive. As a result, the GranTurismo Sport has a top speed of 186 mph and accelerates from
0–62 mph in 4.7 seconds. The performance of the version with the MC Auto Shift gearbox is also much improved,
with a top speed of 185 mph and 0-62 mph in 4.8 seconds.
28
TeChNOlOgy

--- page 32 ---
BYPASS VALVE SYSTEM
The sporting sound of the V8 engine can be expressed in different ways - from a restrained burble when driving
around town, to an invigorating roar out on the open road. It’s the driver who decides this by varying the way the
exhaust gases pass through the system. When the bypass valves are opened they give out a deeper, more throaty
sound that’s so redolent of the Marque of the Trident. With the gearbox in manual, pressing the SPORT button opens
the valves, whilst in Auto Sport mode, the valves open at over 2,500 rpm.
30
TeChNOlOgy

--- page 35 ---
WEIGHT DISTRIBUTION
Both versions of the GranTurismo Sport boast outstanding handling, thanks largely to the balanced weight
distribution, with more load on the rear axle. On the automatic version, the gearbox is mounted directly onto the
engine, so that the weight distribution is 49% to the front and 51% to the rear. This ratio, obtained by moving
the engine behind the front axle, delivers predictable handling and a more relaxed drive - with maximum traction
when accelerating.
The robotic sequential gearshift version offers even greater involvement with the powertrain, thanks to its transaxle
architecture. In cars built on this principle, the engine is located in a mid-front position and connected to the gearbox
mounted on the rear axle. The result is a 48%-52% front-rear weight distribution, with neutral handling that produces
higher lateral acceleration and a more positive entry into bends.
33
TeChNOlOgy

--- page 37 ---
MC AUTO SHIFT AUTOMATIC GEARBOX
With the ZF 6-speed automatic gearbox and hydraulic torque converter, the GranTurismo Sport delivers a relaxed driving experience - but without compromising performance. The transmission,
developed from that of the Quattroporte Sport GT S, runs the MC Auto Shift software and allows the driver to select between five modes: Auto Normal, Auto Sport, Manual Normal, Manual Sport and ICE.
The MC Auto Shift function operates in a variety of ways, depending on the situation. In Manual mode, changes can be made right up to the point when the limiter cuts in, whilst in Manual Sport and
Auto Sport modes, electronic double declutching is possible when downshifting. In Auto Sport mode, with the MSP system deactivated, the high performance MC Start Strategy is enabled. To use it,
the driver simply holds the car on the footbrake, presses down on the accelerator pedal, and does not release the brake until the engine has reached around 2,300 – 2,500 rpm. This results in the car
rocketing from 0-62 mph in just 4.8 seconds.
MC SHIFT ELECTRO-ACTUATED GEARBOX
The higher performance version of the GranTurismo Sport features a 6-speed robotic sequential gearbox, with a twin dry plate clutch. This race-derived transmission delivers a more immediate gearbox
response and enhances the vehicle’s dynamics. The electro-actuated gearbox includes the innovative MC Shift gearchange software, which is activated by pressing the SPORT button on the dashboard
in Manual mode. Thanks to partially overlapping shifting phases, the MC Shift system reduces gearchange times to no more than 100 milliseconds - for a thoroughly engaging and entertaining drive.
35

SPORT SKYHOOK SUSPENSION
The GranTurismo Sport’s double wishbone suspension can be set-up in sport mode and is controlled by the Sport Skyhook System, which has been specially developed for this car. The system
includes new aluminium shock absorbers with continuously variable damping; the ECU receives the data from the acceleration sensors on each wheel and the chassis, processes the information,
and identifies the driving style, as well as the road surface conditions. Using the proportional valves on each damper, the software immediately adjusts their set-up for an even more responsive
ride and improved comfort for all onboard.
Pressing the SPORT button on the dashboard makes the car even more taut and responsive. However, since it continuously adapts to the prevailing road conditions, ride comfort is not compromised.
BRAKING SYSTEM
The GranTurismo Sport has a high performance brake system developed together with Brembo, and employing dual-cast brake disc technology. This combines the high-temperature performance of cast
iron with the light weight of aluminium.
The drilled and slotted discs weigh 15% to 20% less and are more resistant to corrosion and wear. The system’s stability and power is enhanced by the monobloc callipers, with 6 pistons at the front and
4 at the rear, available in the new Anodized Matt Blue colour - a world first for Brembo and Maserati.

ACTIVE SAFETY
MASERATI STABILITY PROGRAM (MSP)
All GranTurismo cars are equipped with the Maserati Stability Program (MSP), an advanced electronic
system which, if the vehicle begins to skid, reduces torque from the engine and activates the brakes to
stabilise it in just a few milliseconds. In addition, the ABS system prevents the wheels from locking whilst
braking, distributes the braking force between the front and rear axles to prevent the rear wheels locking
up, and prevents the drive wheels losing traction on low grip surfaces. When the Sport button is pressed, the
action of the MSP is reduced to allow a much more sporty driving style - the triggering threshold is advanced
and the system acts mainly on the brakes, with less reduction in engine power. The GranTurismo Sport features
even more extreme MSP settings for higher performance but with no compromise in safety.
41
safeTy

--- page 45 ---
PARKING SENSORS
The GranTurismo Sport is fitted with sensors built into both the front and rear bumpers, which assist
manoeuvring in the tightest spaces. The front sensors have an innovative operating mode that recognises
the most potentially dangerous obstacles, whilst their compact dimensions preserve the continuity of the
car’s new aerodynamic spoilers. A dashboard display shows the car surrounded by symbols indicating its
distance from the obstacle, which light up in green, yellow or red depending on how far away it is.
CRUISE CONTROL
The cruise control system automatically maintains the preset cruising speed with no need for pressure on the
accelerator. When this function is activated, a special gearshift operating mode is enabled, with automatic shifting
in response to road gradients.
43
safeTy

--- page 46 ---
TYRE PRESSURE MONITORING SYSTEM (TPMS)
The Tyre Pressure Monitoring System (TPMS) is a device that continuously monitors the tyre pressures
whilst the car is being driven. The tyre pressure is shown on the dashboard display, which warns the
driver if this drops below the optimal level - or in the event of a puncture.
ADAPTIVE HEADLIGHTS
The effectiveness of the Bi-Xenon headlights that feature on the GranTurismo Sport is enhanced by the
rotation function that lights up the road and the verges, increasing night-time cornering safety. The electronic
unit controlling the full and dipped beams instantly receives information on the steering angle, yaw and speed,
and instructs little electric motors to turn the beams in the appropriate direction.
44
safeTy

--- page 49 ---
ELECTRIC PARKING BRAKE (EPB)
The Electronic Parking Brake, which features on all Maserati cars, is engaged by simply pressing a button on
the central tunnel instead of using a conventional mechanical lever. When necessary it can be used when the
car is moving: the system communicates with the stability control system (MSP) and acts on all four wheels
to obtain an immediate braking action (a deceleration of 0.5 g), without any loss of stability, until the control
is released.
HILL HOLDER
To help the driver when starting off on an uphill gradient, the Maserati GranTurismo Sport features a Hill
Holder system. This device keeps the car braked for a short time, thus allowing the driver’s foot to move from
the brake to the accelerator pedal without the car rolling backwards.
47
safeTy

--- page 50 ---
PASSIVE SAFETY
AIR BAGS
The airbag system on the Maserati GranTurismo Sport has four sensors in the front and sides of the car,
and a control unit located near the central tunnel. Thanks to sensors at the front of the car, the front dual-
stage airbags always inflate in direct proportion to the severity of the impact. Extensive simulations and
testing have resulted in the airbag system complying with the most stringent regulations, and providing
the highest levels of occupant protection. Side airbags have been integrated into the new sporty front seats,
which act in conjunction with the drop-down curtain airbags in the roof lining to ensure maximum safety for
all onboard.
SEATBELT PRETENSIONERS AND ACTIVE HEADRESTS
The seatbelts, both front and rear, are fitted with electronically controlled pyrotechnic pretensioners and the latest
generation load limiters. The system communicates with a sensor to determine the seriousness of a collision, and then
activates with precisely the right amount of force to reel in the optimum length of belt. If the car is hit from behind, the
active headrests of the two front seats automatically move in closer to the occupants’ heads to reduce the risk of whiplash
injury. Finally, in the event of a violent collision, an inertia switch deactivates the fuel pumps to minimise the risk of fire
breaking out.
IMMOBILIZER AND ANTI-THEFT SYSTEM
The GranTurismo Sport is protected by an immobiliser that operates via a transponder incorporated in the ignition key,
and a system that includes an anti-lift sensor, ultrasound volumetric sensors, perimetric protection and an alarm inside
the engine compartment. The remote control has three functions: door locking, door unlocking, and boot lid release.
48

CUSTOMISATION
A CAR AS UNIQUE AS YOU ARE
Throughout its long history, Maserati has been renowned for using only the very finest materials and
employing the very best craftsmen. The result has always been high-performance, luxury cars, with exquisite
detailing and an impeccable finish. However, as every owner has their own personal tastes and preferences,
much of the Maserati GranTurismo Sport can be individually customised. A vast choice is available: you can
create innumerable combinations with the ten leather colours for the seats, dashboard, central console, rear
shelf, steering wheel and gear lever knob/bezel. There are then fourteen colours of stitching, including the new Blu
Sofisticato, and nine carpet colours.
53
CUsTOMIsaTION

--- page 56 ---
For those who require an even more dynamic look, MC Sport Line customisation packages are available, which combine the various standard options with features designed to give the car a truly sporty,
dramatic and individualistic appearance. The packages include both styling enhancements (interior and exterior) and functional accessories. All the items available have been developed in competitive
racing by the highly experienced Maserati Corse motorsport team.
Given the racing context, carbon fibre is used extensively in the products found in the MC Sport Line. On the exterior of the GranTurismo Sport, these include the front and rear spoilers, the door mirror
casings, the rear bumper aerodynamic fins and the side skirts with carbon fibre inserts. The external customisation can be then completed with carbon fibre tailpipes and ‘Neptune Design’ alloys in
polished black.
On the inside, the dashboard, central console, door panel and quarter panel mouldings are available in carbon fibre, along with door sills marked with the MC Sport Line logo. The customisation is then
completed with the gearshift paddles, instrumentation surround (featuring GranTurismo MC Stradale graphics) gearshift bezel and Maserati Corse pedal board all machined from aluminium billet.
As you would expect of a car like the GranTurismo Sport, even the suspension is customisable. The ‘Handling Package’ includes a more rigid sports set-up that is lowered by 10 mm, with red springs and
shock absorbers, and the Maserati Stability Program calibrated more towards sporty driving.
54
CUsTOMIsaTION

--- page 59 ---
COMFORT
CLIMATE CONTROL SYSTEM
The automatic dual-zone climate control automatically adjusts the intensity of the ventilation in relation to the outdoor temperature, and allows those onboard to select their own individual heat
settings. The system is fitted with an anti-misting sensor that is programmed to reduce the humidity content of the air as soon as the windows start to mist up.
BOSE® SURROUND SOUND SYSTEM
Those who are very particular about the quality of the sound in their car can chose the Bose® system with Surround Sound that has been specially designed and built to match and blend in with the car’s
acoustics. Starting with the idea that top audio quality should be designed into the car from its very inception, Bose® has created an 11 speaker system that can offer music reproduction on a par with that
of the best concert halls in terms of depth, clarity, and tone.
OTHER EQUIPMENT
The Maserati GranTurismo Sport can be customised still further with other electronic devices, designed to make driving safer and easier. These include electrochromic door mirrors, which darken progressively
as the light from behind increases, thus preventing dazzling (standard on the interior rearview mirror) and HomeLink, a remote control device for opening garage doors that is integrated into the driver’s side
sun visor. For people with more than one property, up to three automatic garage door systems can be programmed in.
57
COMfORT

--- page 60 ---
MASERATI.
A RACING LEGEND
Maserati was founded as a racing car constructor, and its deepest roots are in the world of competition.
After the impressive records set by the MC12, today the Marque’s racing spirit lives on in the Maserati Trofeo MC,
the international single-marque championship for gentleman drivers who wish to compete in the GT class.
TROFEO MC WORLD SERIES. STYLISH TRACK EXCITEMENT.
The Maserati Trofeo MC is one of the most successful international GT racing series. The 2014 season brings a
number of significant innovations and a calendar of great prestige, with events in Hungary, Belgium, England,
America, China and Abu Dhabi, coinciding with WEC, DTM and WTCC series meetings. More races, more excitement
and more challenges, with performance, strategy and consistency making the difference in a unique driving experience.
For more information, visit www.maseraticorse.com or send an email to TrofeoMaserati@maserati.com

MASERATI MASTER DRIVING
It is perhaps the ultimate driving experience: taking to the racetrack in a race-tuned Maserati. A Master Maserati Driving Course places you behind the wheel of all Maserati range models, so that you can learn
about performance driving and other techniques.
MASTER GT 1 DAY
The one-day Master GT course designed to improve participants’ personal driving technique at the wheel of different Maserati. This intensive training programme comprises a number of exciting and dynamic
sessions in high performance cars, and is run by highly trained, specialist staff whose aim is to improve every participant’s personal driving skills in an environment that is enjoyable and challenging for all.
MASTER GT 2 DAYS
An intensive two-day course that focuses on advanced GT driving techniques and safe, yet sporty driving. In a sequence of sessions on the circuit, the driver is taught how to control the car in different
simulated road conditions (e.g. quick direction changes, controlled skids and braking techniques). The ultimate aim is to use the lessons learnt to maximise the enjoyment of driving a high performance Maserati.
MASTER HIGH PERFORMANCE
The programme of Master High Performance course includes advanced high-speed driving and technically more complex exercises that build upon the fundamental skills acquired in the earlier Master GT courses.
The teaching and structure of this course are adapted to the individual needs of the participants, who can improve their driving proficiency through the analysis of Formula 1-type telemetry data.
MASTER ITALIAN LIFESTYLE EXPERIENCE
This exclusive, five star event allows Maserati enthusiasts and their companions to experience the very best that Italy has to offer. Along with a series of Maserati racetrack sessions for the driver, both participants
enjoy a programme of first class activities and excursions in two cities steeped in history and culture: Florence and Parma.
MASTER MASERATI INCENTIVE
The incentive courses last either half a day or a whole day, and include a series of highly stimulating activities. Aside from the thrilling driving sessions on the track, there are practice exercises and competitions
that foster team spirit - hence they provide the perfect context for corporate incentive and team-building events.

MASERATI GENUINE ACCESSORIES
Specially conceived to satisfy our Customers’ needs, the Maserati genuine accessories are a perfect
combination of design and functionality. The attention to detail, style and quality of each individual
accessory reveal the very essence of the Maserati brand, always searching for the perfect balance
between comfort and performance.
The Car Covers and Car Care Products are just a few examples of the “Cleaning and Care” line, designed
to preserve the charm of Maserati cars unaltered over time. “Safety”, a selection of various items including
the Child Seats and the Windscreen water repellent treatment, to travel safely and comfortably. The range
is completed by the “Travel” line accessories, which include the Winter Tyres and the Luggage Compartment
Net, to make the most out of your car. These are just some examples of the several items available, which will
make the Maserati driving experience unique for our Customers.
MASERATI CLASSICHE
Created for enthusiasts and owners of vintage Maserati cars, Maserati Classiche is an organisation that’s
dedicated to those who wish to engage with the marque’s glorious past. The Maserati Classiche range of
products includes items that celebrate the company’s 99 year history: paintings of glorious events, pictures of
classic Maseratis, original reproductions of parts catalogues, owners’ handbooks and old brochures, clothing, scale
models, and much, much more. All the latest items can be found on www.maserati.com in the Maserati – Maserati
Classic section.
